title: urn:qauth:ia:identifier:v1-rc.0
description: Identifier-first sign-in (ADR-020 §3). Every identifier, known or unknown, gets the same next step, so the screen reveals nothing about which accounts exist (ADR-017 Decision 4).

login_hint.description: The identifier: today an email address of at most 254 bytes in email syntax (ADR-017 Decision 3). The server normalises it before use.

amr.description: The RFC 8176 `amr` values a successful answer adds to the transaction: none, because the step proves no authenticator.
